artifacts.summary: Confirms both defects still present in the source store with exact line numbers, and identifies the two in-repo conventions (literature-ingest-online.sh's usage/exit-64 pattern; literature-coverage-delta.sh's parent_doc top-level-document predicate) each fix should reuse.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo's literature extension, when a fix needs a 'is this a top-level document entry vs. a section/chunk entry' predicate over specs/literature-index.json or the global index, reuse literature-coverage-delta.sh's `select(.parent_doc == null or .parent_doc == "")` rather than inventing a path-suffix ('/') check — the two are not equivalent and parent_doc is the canonical distinction other scripts already standardize on.

This repo's literature extension has a shared arg-parsing usage/error convention for standalone scripts: a show_usage() heredoc to stderr, an explicit -h|--help arm that calls it and exits 0, and an unknown-argument default arm that prints 'scriptname: unknown argument: $1' plus usage to stderr and exits 64. literature-ingest-online.sh implements this fully; other literature scripts with looser arg parsing (e.g. a bare catch-all that silently discards unrecognized flags) should be brought in line with it rather than left inconsistent.
